task.pr_title: fix: custom auth headers not stripped on cross-origin redirects

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: `delete redirectOptions.headers[header]` only deletes the lower-case key from `sensitiveHeaders.map(...)`. Axios/follow-redirects header objects can preserve user casing, such as `X-API-Key`, so the PR’s primary example will still leak. Delete by iterating `Object.keys(redirectOptions.headers)` and comparing `name.toLowerCase()` against the sensitive set.
